content: Ops/dashboard surface comparison: Inngest dashboard shows a vertical step timeline with clear success/fail status and plain-language errors, plus bulk replay (re-run many failed functions at once) and AI-specific tracing (prompts/responses/token counts). Temporal's UI/CLI exposes raw event history with engineering vocabulary (WorkflowTaskCompleted, ActivityTaskScheduled) -- powerful but requires domain expertise; workflow reset/retry is largely per-workflow via CLI, no bulk UI action. River's dashboard supports cancel/retry/delete per job and queue pause/concurrency controls. Consistent pattern across all: run/step-level inspection, manual retry, and cancellation are treated as table-stakes ops features, not premium add-ons -- validates entflow's decision to make runs privacy-governed, queryable ent rows with retry as a permitted state transition rather than a bespoke dashboard.
